figurative_meaning_en: Single-minded; absorbed in one thing, focused mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি একচিত্ত হয়ে কাজে মনোনিবেশ করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: She became single-minded in her pursuit of the goal.
The student is focused solely on exam preparation.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots common in Bengali literature
